purpose: Define the exact transition steps for moving the Allen-Dynes Nb3Sn smoke-test rows from policy-blocked diagnostic rows to strict-gate rows if a reviewer accepts the PhysRevB.27.1568 non-mirrored citation route.

transition_steps_if_accepted.action: A reviewer or project policy authority edits only the policy request decision fields.
Do not edit Experiment_Allen_Dynes_Data.py and do not hand-toggle strict_gate_eligible in the input table.
transition_steps_if_accepted.reason: The verifier resolves effective strict eligibility from the policy request at runtime.

transition_steps_if_accepted.expected_effect: Rows with accepted release conditions become effective_strict_gate_eligible=true.
Raw McMillan gate remains an independent artifact and is expected to remain FAIL unless its own inputs are intentionally changed.

expected_after_acceptance.allen_dynes_branch_model_gate_status: PASS for the current Nb3Sn smoke-test row set if no other fields change

not_allowed_by_this_transition: Do not claim topic-level superconductivity PASS from a two-row Nb3Sn smoke test.
Do not claim the APS PDF is repo-mirrored.
Do not treat the policy acceptance as benchmark patch approval.
Do not count calibrated, inverse-fit, or heuristic UET rows in the strict gate.
Do not modify the raw McMillan gate meaning or thresholds.
claim_boundary: This checklist records the accepted transition for the PhysRevB.27.1568 non-mirrored citation route. It does not turn the two-row smoke test into a topic-level PASS and does not approve unrelated source packages.
